description: For software vendors: how to list or claim a product on the AIBuilder Marketplace, the plans and what they cost, and, with product_id, whether that product's marketplace page is research-only or a vendor listing. Read-only: it does not submit anything. Paid plans never change our research, reviews, scores or ranking.
